shadows.name: raised
shadows.purpose: Buttons at rest, badge pills, chips. Barely perceptible lift with thin outline.

shadows.name: card
shadows.purpose: Hover-elevated elements, card containers. First clearly visible separation.

shadows.name: popover
shadows.purpose: Context menus, tooltips, dropdown panels. Clearly above the surface.

shadows.name: modal
shadows.purpose: Dialogs, command palette, confirmation overlays. Maximum app elevation.

shadows.name: window
shadows.purpose: The app window itself. Only used on the outer window element.

shadows.name: highlight-top
shadows.purpose: Top-edge highlight on convex elements (buttons, cards, pills). Light-from-above illusion.

shadows.name: highlight-top-strong
shadows.purpose: Stronger top highlight for the approvals pill and similar high-prominence convex elements.

shadows.name: recess
shadows.purpose: Search and text inputs at rest. Concave feel — the opposite of buttons.

shadows.name: recess-strong
shadows.purpose: Input on focus, combined with the 3px amber glow ring.

shadows.name: pressed
shadows.purpose: Buttons and pills in their active/pressed state after click.

motion.name: dur-press-down
motion.purpose: Button press-down transition. Fast enough to feel immediate.

motion.name: dur-press-up
motion.purpose: Button release transition. Slightly slower than press for tactile feel.

motion.name: dur-flash
motion.purpose: Background color change on hover. Near-instant state feedback.

motion.name: dur-slide
motion.purpose: Active sidebar indicator slide between items. Tab underline slide. The signature motion.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Exponential ease-out for elements entering or sliding. Fast start, graceful settle.

motion.name: ease-snap
motion.purpose: Material standard ease for background/color transitions. Snappy, not bouncy.

narrative.overview:
FilePlus feels like a workspace that has been used and trusted for years: dark surfaces with the warmth of quality materials, not darkness as aesthetic posture. The physical scene that forced the dark theme: a developer at a desk in the evening, two monitors, files scattered across drives that need organizing, wanting to get in and get out without the tool demanding attention.

The hotel lobby note: ambient wayfinding. Everything the user might need is present and legible without requiring them to search for it. No element demands a second glance. Navigation signs are visible but not loud. The space does its job while staying in the background.

The material quality: machined precision. Tight tolerances, nothing soft, but the tightness is smooth rather than sharp. Buttons depress cleanly and release quickly. Transitions are fast enough to feel immediate but present enough to confirm causality.
keyCharacteristics: Deep warm-purple base with a single Burnt Amber accent used sparingly
Tactile chrome (convex buttons, convex cards, concave inputs) on intentionally flat content lists
Two typefaces, used without exception: Inter for all UI, JetBrains Mono for all data-class text
Motion limited to state confirmation: 50-180ms, ease-out exponential, never decorative
Restrained color strategy: accent on 10% or less of any surface
Full light mode support: warm cream palette mirroring the dark surface hierarchy

rules.name: The One Amber Rule
rules.body: Burnt Amber appears on 10% or less of any given surface. If every sidebar item glows amber, nothing is selected. Rarity is the signal.

rules.name: The Flat-Content Rule
rules.body: File rows, list items, scan results, and data tables have no background, no border, and no shadow at rest. Depth comes from the tonal placement of the parent surface. Elevation is reserved for chrome.

rules.name: The Wash-Not-Solid Rule
rules.body: Semantic colors and the accent appear in content areas only as wash variants (10-18% alpha tints) with matching edge variants for borders. Never a solid accent or semantic background in a content list.

rules.name: The Two-Font Rule
rules.body: Inter for everything the user reads as UI copy. JetBrains Mono for everything the user reads as a data value. These roles never swap. A file name is UI (Inter). A file path is data (Mono). A button label is UI. A file size is data.

rules.name: The No-Weight-Wall Rule
rules.body: No two adjacent text elements share the same size and weight. Hierarchy requires contrast on at least one axis: scale must differ by at least one step, or weight must shift by at least 100.

rules.name: The Convex-Concave Rule
rules.body: Buttons, pills, cards, and badges are convex (top highlight + drop shadow). Inputs are concave (inset recess, no highlight). These two directions never appear on the same element.

rules.name: The Blur Boundary Rule
rules.body: Backdrop-filter blur is permitted only on temporary overlays: modals, command palette, tray popout. Explicitly prohibited on sidebar, toolbar, content panes, and file lists.

dos: Do use JetBrains Mono for every data-class string: file paths, sizes, hashes, timestamps, counts, keyboard shortcuts.
Do give every interactive element a data-action attribute in kebab-case describing its intended function.
Do represent all state variants inline in HTML: one active example, commented-out alternates for every other state.
Do put inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.06) on every convex chrome element so it reads as physically lifted.
Do express selected and active states in content areas using wash+edge tints (rgba 10-18% fill, rgba 40% border).
Do keep file rows and list items completely flat at rest. No card treatment in file lists.
Do limit blur to temporary overlays: modals, command palette, tray popout, context menus.
donts: Don't look like Windows Explorer: no sparse whitespace, no flat header-bar-only chrome.
Don't look like Total Commander or Directory Opus: no competing toolbar rows, no crowded multi-column headers.
Don't foreground the AI: no pulsing indicators, no gradient glow around AI results, no badge that says 'AI filed this.'
Don't look like a SaaS dashboard: no hero-metric cards, no purple-to-blue gradient sidebar, no gradient text.
Don't use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored accent stripe on any row, card, callout, or alert.
Don't use background-clip:text with a gradient. All text is a single solid color.
Don't apply backdrop-filter blur to the sidebar, toolbar, content panes, or file lists.
Don't use the same padding value everywhere. Vary rhythm to communicate structure.
Don't use cards inside file lists or anywhere data density is the priority.
